## Problem

What did you expect, and what happened? Include the steps to reproduce it.

## Environment

- Package name and `[BUILD]` marker:
- NRO SHA-256, if available:
- Switch model and handheld/docked mode:
- Boot environment and Sleeping Dogs forwarder:
- CPU / GPU / RAM clocks:
- Renderer / FEX mode / graphics profile:
- Game resolution and relevant Advanced Options:
- LSFG OFF/ON and motion resolution:
- Last working build, if this is a regression:

## Logs and screenshots

Attach `fex-runtime.log`, `crash.log` if produced, and relevant DXVK logs or
screenshots. Save the log before the next launch. Do not attach game files,
keys or proprietary shader payloads.
